data.text:
Kallu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Food ... on 1 April, 2024 
Author: Sangeeta Chandra
Bench: Sangeeta Chandra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:26798-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 2867 of 2024
Petitioner :- Kallu
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Food Safety And Drug Administration Civil S
Counsel for Petitioner :- Rohitash Kumar Singh Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ram Kumar Singh Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel who appears on behalf of the State Respondents and Sri Ram Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the opposite parties no. 2 and 3 . 
2. This writ petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"i. To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus thereby directing the Opp. Party No.2 to decide the question of issuance of license/representation date 20.12.2023 pending before his as contained in ANNEXURE No.1."
Kallu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Food ... on 1 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26170865/
1 3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner's father was running a butcher shop for beef before his death and license was issued by the opposite party no.3 in the name of his father. The petitioner has applied for license for doing the same business, but this license has not been issued despite his application having been made in January, 2023. 
4. Sri Ram Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the opposite parties no.2 and 3, on the basis of instructions, says that the petitioner should apply online for grant of such license, he has not done so and therefore his application made on plain piece of paper cannot be considered. 
5. This writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to make an online application following due procedure as provided in the Rules as framed for the same within a period of six weeks from today. If such an application is made within the time prescribed by us in this order, the opposite parties no.2 and 3 shall consider the same in accordance with the rules and pass appropriate orders within ten weeks thereafter.
. 
(Brij Raj Singh, J.) (Sangeeta Chandra,J.) Order Date :- 1.4.2024 dk/
